title: Marginal Calibration Masks Generator Differences in Held-Out Evaluation of Multivariate Time Series, with an Application to ERA5 Weather Sequences
description: Reproducibility package for the StatD2GAN v3 study, a held-out re-evaluation of a multi-discriminator GAN for multivariate weather sequences: the final two calendar years of each ERA5 series are held out behind a 168-hour embargo, calibration is fitted on the training block only, and the decision rules were frozen before any result was seen (protocol sha256 2d9a3b9d210df5b2...). The v3 campaign comprises 275 runs: 9 ablation arms of StatD2GAN and re-implemented RCGAN and TimeGAN baselines, at 5 ERA5 locations with 5 seeds each. This release (v2.0.0; internal labels: frozen campaign v3.0.0, post-freeze layer v3.1.0) contains the frozen v3.0.0 code, run records, results and ERA5 inputs unchanged (MANIFEST.json), a post-freeze reporting layer (MANIFEST_post_freeze.json), a one-command build (make all) and the 275 generator weight files as five per-location archives (weights_manifest.json). ERA5: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store, DOI 10.24381/cds.adbb2d47, CC-BY; contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2026.
